questions.prompt: Why does Anna reject the mountain holiday?
questions.explanation: high places 指高处，直接说明她不喜欢山顶度假的理由。怕沙子的是 Professor Bot 的玩笑；Anna 后来还明确说不要骑马。
options: She only wants to ride horses.

questions.prompt: How does the Deep Sea Adventure compare in price with the Mountain Getaway?
questions.evidence: It is pricier than the Mountain Getaway.
questions.explanation: pricier than 是 price 的比较表达，表示比山地套餐更贵。不要把 better 的推荐话术误读成价格更低；same 和 free 都与原句不符。

spokenEvidence.quote: It is pricier than the Mountain Getaway.

questions.prompt: Which holiday does Dan describe as the most expensive?
questions.evidence: You need the Safari Camp Out! It is our priciest vacation.
questions.explanation: priciest 是最高级，表示几种套餐中最贵的。Deep Sea 只被说成比 Mountain 更贵，不能因此推断它是最高价。

spokenEvidence.quote: You need the Safari Camp Out! It is our priciest vacation.

questions.prompt: What is Anna’s favourite way to travel? Write ONE WORD for the transport.
questions.evidence: My favorite way of traveling is by train.
questions.explanation: by train 表示乘火车，是 Anna 明确说最喜欢的方式。plane、helicopter、ship 是用来比较害怕程度的其他交通方式，不能用提及次数来判断喜好。

spokenEvidence.quote: My favorite way of traveling is by train.

questions.prompt: Why does Anna dislike bicycle tours?
questions.evidence: Biking is THE slowest AND least romantic way to travel.
questions.explanation: slowest 与 least romantic 分别表示最慢、最不浪漫。这里的 least 不能看成 most；对飞机的害怕或骑骆驼与这个理由不同。
answers: She finds them the slowest and least romantic.
options: She finds them the slowest and least romantic.
She believes bicycles are the most frightening aircraft.
She says every bicycle tour goes through a desert.

spokenEvidence.quote: Biking is THE slowest AND least romantic way to travel.

questions.prompt: What problem does Anna notice with the Travel Max 2000?
questions.evidence: No, I mean it’s really on fire!
questions.explanation: Anna 用 really on fire 说明机器真的着火，而 Dan 先把 on fire 理解为情绪高涨、销售热情。要区分这段双关，不是票务或住宿预订出错。
options: It has printed the wrong ticket.
It has booked a mountain cabin.

spokenEvidence.quote: No, I mean it’s really on fire!
